features.title: One digital assistant, four intelligent capabilities
features.subtitle: Every chapter you upload is processed by a neural AI pipeline and streamed back to you live — no refreshing, no waiting around.

summary.title: AI-Powered Summarization Engine
summary.description: Long, dense chapters condensed by a neural engine into clear, well-structured knowledge summaries that keep the key definitions and arguments intact.

translation.title: Neural Academic Translation
translation.description: AI-driven Arabic translations that preserve scientific terminology and the original structure of the text.

quiz.title: Smart Self-Assessment Quizzes
quiz.description: Multiple-choice questions generated by AI straight from your chapter, with instant scoring and explanations.

pronunciation.title: Automated Voice Pronunciation
pronunciation.description: Hear key academic terms spoken aloud using your browser's built-in text-to-speech, right from the summary.

realtime.title: Live AI Processing Pipeline
realtime.description: Background AI jobs stream results to your screen the moment they're ready via WebSockets — no polling.

routing.title: Adaptive AI Model Routing
routing.description: Administrators can route each task to a different AI provider and model without touching a line of code.

steps.title: From upload to study session in three steps

upload.title: Upload your chapter

process.title: AI processes it in the background
process.description: Summarization, translation, and quiz generation run as background jobs so you're never stuck waiting.

study.title: Study with live results
study.description: Switch between Summary, Translation, Quiz, and Pronunciation tabs as results stream in in real time.
